mapper.sql: FROM social_match sm JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} JOIN sport s ON s.sport_id = sm.sport_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.application_type = '개인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS individual_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.application_type = '동호회' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS club_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.status = '확정' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_count FROM match_application ma JOIN social_match sm ON sm.match_id = ma.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} WHERE sm.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND sm.start_at >= #{startAt} AND sm.start_at <= #{endAt} AND sm.status = '종료' AND (ma.group_application_id IS NULL OR ma.group_application_id = ma.application_id)

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(sm.start_at) AS weekday, HOUR(sm.start_at) AS hour, COUNT(mp.participant_id) AS participant_count FROM match_participant mp JOIN social_match sm ON sm.match_id = mp.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} WHERE sm.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND sm.start_at >= #{startAt} AND sm.start_at <= #{endAt} AND sm.status = '종료' AND mp.participation_status = '확정' GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(sm.start_at), HOUR(sm.start_at)
